## Service

`name`, `description`. Kept separate from `Plan` per the domain-neutral rule: Plan is the recurring tier, Service is one-time/ad-hoc. Same Price-lookup pattern as Plan — no stored back-link.

### Non-goals
Does not carry billing interval or amount — that's `Price`.

### Example
`linkedExamples` points at `Service/onboarding-package`, a real one-time onboarding engagement instance.
attributes.cardDescription: A billable, non-recurring unit (implementation, support hours, onboarding), kept separate from Plan.
